entities.summary: HJIM van Gasteren is the pseudonym of Henriëtte Johanna Ignatia Maria van Gasteren, a Dutch multimedia artist known for her often controversial self-portraits. Of former presidents Formerly known as Lilith Love, she changed her artist name in 2020. Her work frequently explores themes such as identity, femininity, female archetypes, gender bending, freedom and equality.
